sources.title: We burned 11.7bn tokens to find the best cyber AI model
sources.snippet: We burned 11.7 billion tokens to benchmark the cyber capabilities of 10 AI models with three attempts each, given 32 fresh off-the-shelf vulns to rediscover. This benchmark is an evolution of our earlier known-CVE benchmark with a fresh, harder dataset, more models, and a closer look at what they find, how reliably they find it, and their quirks and trade-offs.
